title: Needle entry on the patient
view: The face from the front, head at the top, the patient's right on the image left. The operator's gloved hand comes from the patient's right.
teachingPoint: Index fingertip on the foramen below the pupil; thumb lifting the upper lip; needle into the mucobuccal fold above the first premolar, pointing at the fingertip.
claims: Face from the front, patient's right on the image left (house laterality).
Index fingertip over the infraorbital foramen, about 1 cm below the orbital rim on the pupil line (record, steps 2 and subtitle).
Thumb lifting the upper lip (record, steps 4).
Needle entering the mucobuccal fold above the first premolar, directed at the fingertip (record, steps 5).
Two labels: Infraorbital foramen, Mucobuccal fold.

geometry.why: foramen is on the pupil line
the index fingertip is on the foramen
the thumb lifts the upper lip
entry is in the mucobuccal fold
entry is above the first premolar
needle comes from below the foramen
the fold entry is medial to the foramen, so the needle angles up and laterally
the needle never points at the orbit
